stills.prompt: Low-key interior: a near-black stone workshop with almost no ambient light. On a worn charcoal stone workbench, one complete small single-cylinder horizontal mill engine seen in side profile: brass cylinder at the left end, crosshead and connecting rod in the middle, and at the right end a black iron flywheel with exactly six straight spokes mounted on the crankshaft, part of the same machine. Aged-gold (#C6A94F) brass dulled at the edges with faint fingerprints and a thin oil sheen, on a black iron bed. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left and draws a bright edge along the flywheel rim; everything else falls off into black. Empty bench space to the right of the engine. No lamps in frame, no windows, no people, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
